item.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
item.description: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Michael Millard

item.title: NEAR Intents recovers entire stolen $3.8M after ultimatum to exploiter
item.description: The exploiter returned the entire sum to NEAR Intents after being identified and given 48 hours to respond.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Michael Millard

item.title: Community banks sue OCC over trust bank charters of crypto firms
item.description: Community banking group’s lawsuit claims OCC has overstepped its mandate from Congress.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Michael Millard

item.title: Trump is expected to appoint Jay Clayton as new AI czar: Reports
item.description: US intel chief Clayton may be asked to also oversee AI innovation and development along with “self policing” tech CEOs.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Michael Millard

item.title: European crypto users have ‘more faith’ in regulated firms under MiCA: Bitpanda co-CEO
item.description: Speaking on Cointelegraph’s Chain Reaction, Christian Trummer said MiCA has increased trust in regulated platforms and called for stricter enforcement against noncompliant firms.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Nate Kostar

item.title: $4.2B crypto bank Anchorage Digital cuts 17% of workforce: Report
item.description: The reported cuts come as Anchorage expands its institutional footprint, including stablecoin issuance and a $100 million investment from Tether.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Sam Bourgi

item.title: Blast to wind down Ethereum L2 after costs outpace revenue
item.description: Once among Ethereum’s largest layer-2 networks by total value locked, Blast is urging users to move their assets to mainnet ahead of the shutdown.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Nate Kostar

item.title: 71% of UK finance leaders expect tokenization to reshape financial services: Lloyds
item.description: A Lloyds survey found that faster payments and settlement are the most significant perceived benefits of tokenization, as the UK builds infrastructure for tokenized finance.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Nate Kostar

item.title: Crypto’s billions are back, but the premiums aren’t
item.description: Kalshi seeks a $40 billion valuation, while Blockchain.com targets an IPO and crypto treasury companies struggle to maintain their once-high valuations.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Sam Bourgi

item.title: Bitcoin briefly hits $87K as weak US jobs data sends bond yields lower
item.description: Bitcoin climbed after weaker-than-expected payrolls pushed Treasury yields lower, but order-book resistance kept BTC from reaching new macro highs.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by William Suberg

item.title: ‘Euro stablecoin isn’t enough’: EU issuers make case for USD tokens
item.description: European issuers say Europe cannot ignore demand for dollar stablecoins as businesses seek USD liquidity for global payments and settlement.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Helen Partz

item.title: Furious debate about THORChain vs NEAR shows idealism has limits
item.description: The furious debate over Bitget’s $387.7M of hacked funds comes down to whether ideals around “permissionless and decentralized” tech means never intervening — even if you could.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Christina Comben

item.title: Circle urges EU to revise stablecoin reserve rules in MiCA review
item.description: Circle wants the EU to replace mandatory bank-deposit minimums with more flexible liquidity rules and preserve cross-border stablecoin issuance.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Yohan Yun

item.title: BNB Chain crosses $1B in tokenized stocks, ETFs as market hits $3.7B
item.description: Tokenized stocks and ETFs on BNB Chain reached $1.1 billion as the broader market climbed to $3.7 billion, putting the network’s share at roughly 30%.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Helen Partz

item.title: Bitcoin treasuries may struggle to match Strategy, says Ammous
item.description: Strategy’s scale and cash reserves give it an edge over treasury rivals, according to Saifedean Ammous, author of “The Bitcoin Standard.”
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Yohan Yun

item.title: CONNECT recap: Arthur Hayes on money printing, Wall Street moves onchain
item.description: Arthur Hayes said money printing could lift crypto prices, while CONNECT Seoul speakers examined Wall Street’s competitive edge onchain.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Yohan Yun

item.title: Bitcoin reaches for $87K as short liquidations top $120M
item.description: Bitcoin buyers broke through a wall of ask liquidity to reach new October BTC price highs near $87,800, with the area immediately above now a new resistance hurdle.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by William Suberg

item.title: Aave founder says V3 unaffected after third-party adapter exploit drains $305K
item.description: Aave founder Stani Kulechov said Aave v3 was unaffected after an attacker exploited a third-party adapter to drain about $305,000 from two Safe multisig wallets.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Ezra Reguerra

item.title: Porsche’s ‘long haul’ Web3 project ends in less than four years
item.description: Porsche is winding down its Web3 project and Pioneers Circle community as trading activity in its 911 NFT collection falls sharply from early levels.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Ezra Reguerra

item.title: Bitcoin ETFs kick off ‘Uptober’ with $103M inflow
item.description: Bitcoin ETFs returned to inflows with $103 million, while Ether funds recorded a third straight day of net outflows.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Helen Partz

item.title: South Korea crypto exchange profits fall 78% in H1 amid trading slump
item.description: South Korean crypto exchange operating profits fell 78% in the first half of 2026 as trading volumes, market capitalization and customer deposits declined.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Ezra Reguerra

item.title: South Korea advances tokenized securities rules ahead of 2027 rollout
item.description: South Korea’s financial regulator proposed detailed rules for tokenized securities, including capital requirements, OTC trading licenses and retail investment limits.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Ezra Reguerra

item.title: Zano exploiter minted more than a quadrillion fUSD before blockchain rollback
item.description: The unauthorized coins were indistinguishable from legitimate ZANO, leaving the team unable to remove them without rolling back the blockchain.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Felix Ng

item.title: Core Lightning warns attackers are targeting unpatched nodes
item.description: Node operators running version 26.06.7 or earlier were told to upgrade immediately.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Felix Ng

item.title: Ethereum’s zkAPI brings privacy-preserving API payments to mainnet
item.description: Ethereum’s zkAPI is now live on mainnet, turning an earlier zero-knowledge API payment proposal into a working implementation for private, prepaid access.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Ezra Reguerra

item.title: NEAR Intents says it’s identified the hacker, gives 48-hour ultimatum
item.description: “We have identified you, sir,” NEAR Intents general manager Alex Shevchenko said on Friday after the protocol was hacked for $3.8 million.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Felix Ng

item.title: SEC moves to clear custody hurdle for advisers offering crypto
item.description: Custody requirements have kept some investment advisers from offering certain crypto to clients, a regulatory hurdle the SEC’s proposal could remove.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Felix Ng

item.title: China warns foreign spies about crypto, Singapore dominates Asia: Asia Express
item.description: Singapore’s crypto economy grows 55%, South Korea set to make crypto market makers legal, and Chinese spy ministry warns would-be foreign spies it’s watching the blockchain.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Andrew Fenton

item.title: Evernorth clears shareholder vote ahead of Nasdaq debut with 473M XRP treasury
item.description: Evernorth expects to begin trading on Nasdaq under the ticker XRPN after its SPAC merger closes, with an XRP treasury worth roughly $710 million at current prices.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Nate Kostar

item.title: Trump to host 3rd ‘exclusive’ memecoin event amid corruption claims
item.description: The president is scheduled to appear at his golf club in Washington, DC, at a Nov. 22 dinner for his top 185 memecoin holders, following similar events in May 2025 and April 2026.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Turner Wright
